description: Code Mode for a self-hosted media stack: run one JavaScript async arrow function in a sandbox whose callables reach Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, Tautulli, Overseerr, Bazarr, SABnzbd, qBittorrent, Plex and Jellyfin. One bin serves a small CLI and a stdio MCP server with a single tool.
name: @reneturcios/mediafleet
